Where do I even start?! From the moment we arrived, The Phoenician delivered an unforgettable experience of luxury, ease, and pure indulgence. Every single detail... from the breathtaking views of Camelback Mountain to the impeccably designed rooms... made this birthday getaway feel like a true oasis in the desert.

The property itself is immaculate; modern elegance with a classic touch. The grounds are perfectly maintained, the pools are serene and photo-worthy, and the spa? Absolutely divine. I spent hours unwinding at the rooftop spa pool, and I can honestly say I left floating.

But what really made this stay exceptional was the service. Every staff member we encountered was warm, attentive, and genuinely helpful...from valet to concierge to the poolside attendants. They didn’t just meet expectations, they anticipated our needs. One staff member even gave us spot-on recommendations for local restaurants and lounges that ended up being highlights of our trip.

This hotel understands the meaning of true hospitality. Whether you’re celebrating a special occasion or just in need of a luxurious escape, The Phoenician will wrap you in comfort, class, and a kind of care that’s hard to put into words.

I can't wait to return. Consider this my official love letter to The Phoenician.

We recently celebrated our 17th anniversary with a stay at The Phoenician and decided to bring the kids along for a family-friendly experience. We booked a double queen room with a beautiful view of the pool, excited for a relaxing staycation.

While the beginning of our visit didn’t go as smoothly as hoped—the room wasn’t ready at the 4 PM check-in time, and we ended up waiting over an hour—the staff was courteous and responsive. They apologized for the inconvenience and offered a $150 resort credit. Later, we received a call informing us the room was still not available, but they offered us an upgrade to a spacious casita by the golf course, which was a fantastic solution.

From that point on, our stay was wonderful. The kids had a great time at the pool and enjoyed the evening activities. We capped off our nights with family game time playing Nintendo together. The resort itself is stunning, with top-notch amenities and beautifully maintained grounds.

Despite the rocky start, the way the staff handled the situation truly stood out. Their professionalism and commitment to guest satisfaction turned our visit into a memorable experience. The Phoenician is an excellent resort, perfect for both getaways and staycations, and we appreciate their efforts to make our anniversary special.

We also returned to our room around 9:45pm to find our keys did not work anymore. We called front desk twice, and they assured someone was coming to help us into our room. No one came, but after an hour we found a maintenance worker who was driving by in a golf cart to help us in.

We made our reservations almost three months in advance and didn't want to be in the family area with children (we have 9 of our own between the four families). I think it's really "bush-league" to move us a week out when we're planning 12 room nights over the three days.  We ended up at the Family pool at a discount but this wasn't about the money, it was about respecting your guests (my wife is Titanium level, my brothers and I are also Bonvoy elite levels). As I told the woman who called, in addition to playing golf, dining, reserving the cabanas and so many other things, we spent a lot of money there and would have likely chosen another resort back in January if we were told there weren't any cabanas. We stayed for two nights/one day at the Phoenician with our 4 and 6 yo kids. The reason my overall rating is not excellent is because the splash pad, waterslide and whirlpools were all broken the day we were there. The splash pads and whirlpools did get going midafternoon, but the waterslide remained out of order. The games room was available and we played some foosball, pool and air hockey, but two of the 4 arcade games were out of order. When travelling with two young kids....what else are you supposed to do with them in a fancy resort! The kids water area was the main reason we picked the Phoenician. 

The building itself is very nice, the rooms are large, the staff are incredibly kind and friendly and the food was delicious. Would I stay here again with my kids? No,  unless there was a way to ensure the kid water activities area was fully functional. Would I stay here again with my partner, or on a friends trip? Yes.

reviews.title: Swimming in Luxury, Drowning in Fees
reviews.text:
As a husband who spent five days at The Phoenician in Scottsdale with my pregnant wife, I have mixed feelings about the resort. The location is perfect with easy access to the airport, shopping, and great restaurants. However, the prices are extortionate, and the additional fees and charges are annoying.

On arrival day, they delivered a bottle of non-alcoholic sparkling cider and sweets, which was a nice touch. The staff was exceptional, and our Grand Room with a pool view was comfortable. The pools were great, and the grounds were beautiful.

The prices at The Phoenician are steep. Our room rate was $700 per night, and additional fees added up quickly. There's a daily required resort fee of $45 per day, and a daily rate of $85 for occupancy/tourism fee. Daily parking fees and room service charges are also high, delivery fees, 22% surcharges and blank tip lines begging to be filled in.

The spa prices are crazy, and we were shocked by the bill for my wife's 80-minute facial, which ended up being $400 with an additional $80 surcharge. We had expected it to cost around $200-250 and should have asked before booking. 

While The Phoenician provides a great experience, the value for money just isn't justified in our eyes. We won't be returning unless the nightly rate ever gets down to  $400-$450. Although, if you're swimming in cash and don’t mind fees, 22% surcharges, and ambiguous tip lines don't faze you, I'd recommend it. Just be prepared to swipe that credit card.

reviews.title: The Go-To Luxury Resort
reviews.text: Over the past 4-5 years, my wife and I have traveled to Scottsdale at least twice per year.  The Phoenician is quickly becoming our favorite resort.  With its proximity to Camelback, you have excellent views and only a short trip from the airport.  The food, whether its an upscale dinner at J&G or poolside eating Mediterranean options, is top-notch.  As a bonus, the Phoenician always has very healthy options, regardless of which meal you’re eating.  On the recreation/activities side, it can’t be beat.  With an excellent on-site golf course, tennis and spa, my wife and I can enjoy all the activities without having to leave the resort.  Last, the accommodations are always first-class.  The rooms are well appointed, always in excellent shape, and within a reasonable distance from all that the resort has to offer.

reviews.text:
Dead roach noted when pulled out sofa bed and didn't appear to have been cleaned with new sheets, couch not clean carpet not clean, concierge not very helpful, restaurant food mediocre, served warm water with no ice during heat wave, server not very knowledgeable and didn't take initiative.  The employees gave the impression that they were being bothered and not very good with customer service.  Not treated like a 5 star.

The best experience was at the Phoenician Tavern.  From the minute I arrived and walked in the door, the employees were cheerful, knowledgeable, and took initiative. When asked for one thing, we were brought several.  They didn't serve coke only Pepsi, but went out of their way to find and sever my group Coke. Food was amazing.  My server didn't give an attitude like she was being bothered, but rather cheerful and glad to answer questions.  Beyond excellent customer service.

reviews.text: Everything was seamless from the valet to the bellman to check-in, easy and quick. Our room was ready but we went for a drink and the front desk called us about 25 mins later to tell us our room was ready. The bellman brought our luggage and kindly went a refilled a cooler with ice and brought it back to us. Concierge made reservations for us at the hotel restaurants. The food at Mowery & Cotton was outstanding. Our waitress Pang, at the Tavern was amazing and beyond attentive. Room was perfect. My neice has difficulty walking and they made sure to put us in a room that was centrally located to the restaurants and the pool. They gave us a ride down to the Tavern restaurant by the golf course so you didn’t have to walk in the heat. Just outstanding. My only complaint would be the pool. It was 116 degrees outside and everyone was looking to the pool to cool off but the pool was so warm it felt terrible. I’m not familiar with how most hotels deal with extreme heat and if they are able to pump in cold water but it was a huge disappointment since we couldn’t use it as a way to cool down. We left after 30-minutes. This wouldn’t stop me from staying here again and again.

reviews.text: My wife's gift for my 60th birthday was a 4 night stay at The Phoenician.  We loved it. The bed was extremely comfortable. The decor understated, but elegant. The pools were nice. The cactus garden was fascinating!  We went there every day. We never left to dine elsewhere, and although it was pricey, it was excellent. My wife is a gourmet cook and is a good judge. We just opted for the appetizers, since we don't eat much anyway and the entrees were in the order of $40 / piece. You may want to stop by a grocery store to get snacks and breakfast options on your way to the hotel.  Oh, and, the pools are open 24/7, so skinny dipping at an early 4:30am provided a private experience. It was as if we owned the place.

reviews.title: A wonderful weekend away
reviews.text: The photos definitely made the resort grounds look larger and in better condition than it was when we arrived. While it was still lovely, the grounds were not as expansive and manicured as we expected from photos. The “adults only” pool is situated directly between the 2 family pools, so while kids were not in the water, they were still walking through the pool deck to get from one to the other, and a loud water slide is right next to it. Make sure to get chairs on the opposite side of you want to relax without the sounds of that. We had wonderful experiences with all the staff- the pool manager Josef was so kind and helpful, and our waiters at each restaurant we friendly and on point. reviews.text: Excellent athletic club.  Very nice golf course which uses dynamic pricing methodology(200-250/round- no price reduction hotel guests).  Amazing pool with excellent wait staff in pool area.  Pool area and clothing store use paper process for room charges so some potential for fraud and error I think.  We bought few small gifts for 76.80 in one of on-site stores and my hotel bill was charged in error 7680.00.  Unfortunately, based on this charge hotel computer system then began posting many additional holds on my credit card totaling 65 k.  My credit card company notified us regarding suspicious activity occurring at resort and card was cancelled.  One of the managers was able correct the 7600.00 error after reviewing store receipts, but whole event was distressing and caused us to utilize outside resort food and shopping options as we were concerned about property process and charge reliability.  Phone system also suboptimal-  a lot of wait time on phone when calling front desk.

reviews.text: The Phoenician wasn’t horrible. It was just lackluster. I’m going to assume it’s due to the pandemic. Our stay began in a stressful manner as I was not on the manifest upon arrival, so the security told me I wasn’t a guest. He did allow me through to get the issue situated with the front desk after showing him my itinerary. Once arriving at the front desk, they too looked perplexed and could not find my name. Luckily, they eventually did and that got squared away. The other issues were minor, but inconvenient. For example, when I called the front desk for beverages (of any kind), I was told by Sarah, the customer support associate, that their restaurant had closed, in room service is suspended until further notice, and they did not have to purchase. So, I had to request valet, leave the complex, and find a 24 hour Walgreens or something, just to purchase a bottle of water because I was thirsty. The shops throughout the complex had odd hours and closed early as well. The resort just did not cater to guest experiences, but the guest had to cater their experience to the resort. Other than that, the room itself was excellent (minus the few amenities to be expected- coffee maker/ice bucket). I just felt the guest experience could be more.

reviews.title: Wedding Night Stay Review
reviews.text:
I’ll start by saying the hotel was beautiful & clean and most employees we interacted with were kind. So they get some points for that. 

However, I stayed there on August 29 for my wedding night. I called the front desk at 10am that morning and asked for the possibility of a 3pm check in (regular check in is 4pm) as the wedding started at 4:30pm and my husband wanted to check us in before arriving at the nearby venue. I would have understood if not but the front desk concierge on the phone was very kind and said not a problem and she was moving us to the priority check in list, she was recently engaged and was so excited for us! She said I’ll put you on the 11am clean list so you’ll be good to go this afternoon when he comes by. Fast forward to 3pm, my husband arrives to check in and get dressed before the big night and the front desk VERY rudely explains our room isn’t ready and acts as if we’re insane to think it would be. I’m going to mention at this point it’s 40 minutes before a typical check in - and I was your priority check in? You can’t find a clean room to let my husband get ready for our wedding in? If there was a chance we couldn’t check in, the lady should have mentioned that in the morning. Or at the very least the staff could have been nice and we would have received it better. They were rude and cold. I’m not surprised because every time I spoke to this hotel leading up to the day there was inconsistency in customer service.

reviews.text:
Due to COVID we had a very small wedding.  Afterwards, we went to the Phoenician for a mini moon.  We arrived later in the evenig in a wedding dress and suit.  The front desk gave us a room that was all fhe way at the very end of the hallway.  We walked, feet hurting and all.  Once we got there the room was a disappointment. It had dirty floors, spots on the furniture, the nightstands looked as if they hadn't been wiped down, and little speckels of dirt on the bed sheets.  

The whole reason we chose the resort was due to its 5-star rating, especially during these times.  We called to switch rooms.  They made it sound like it was the fact that the room was at the end of the hall that we called.  The new room was closer to the elevator and cleaner.  However,  they took away our view.  Bottom line, no one cared that this was a special weekend for us or the fact that i walked acroas the hotel in my wedding gown.  

We made the best of it once we were in a clean and sanitized room.  The pool was lovely and the weekend ended up being successful.   However, I am not planning on going back.  There are nicer, more accomodating resorts in the area.  

I understand times are strange.  But cleaning the rooms should be top priority. Customer service should also be of outmost importance.  These times will pass and all that will be left are negative reviews and unhappy customers.

I would not recommend this hotel to anyone.

I could have paid far less monies at another hotel and would receive better service. The employees of the hotel class down the place.

reviews.text: We loved everything about this hotel, excellent service, amazing pool area, fabulous design, comfortable and spacious bedrooms. We will definitely go back!

Luckily, after bringing all this to their attention they rightfully took off the parking and resort fee. I commend then for doing right by a Marriott Rewards member. Have seen much more interesting and prettier pool areas at similar level resorts.

reviews.title: Over priced but great location

This is a great hotel, we just found it to be overpriced. 

Adult pool is REALLY small and there are very limited "free" chairs. There were a ton of empty chairs that require you to purchase a cabana. Food at the pool was good - service was NOT. 

Spa is beautiful but also overpriced in comparison to neighboring resorts. 

Main bar in the lobby had a great vibe at night with live music.

Room was very standard but clean. Bed/bedding/pillows were very comfortable. 

There are A LOT of stairs to go every where on property. Be prepared!

reviews.text: After booking in Expedia I inquired with the hotel directly about getting a room we previously stayed in.  When I was notified that there would be an upgrade charge I informed them that I had in fact booked the Mountain View.  They said what Expedia sent them was not and I could pat extra. In the end they removed it.

Service is impeccable and the accommodations are of the highest quality along with the wonderful pool areas.
reviews.author: Gymrat

reviews.text: The stay at the Phoenician was a big disappointment and we decided to cut our week long stay short and left. Why this place is rated 5 stars is beyond me. We booked one of their Casitas, which is basically just a simple room on the opposite side of the main building, further away from the pool and shops. We arrived around 8pm when it was dark and it happened to rain. In a place of this class, I would have expected, that someone would take us and our luggage to the room, but instead I was just shown on a map where our room was supposed to be. Nobody asked about our 4 pieces of luggage or offered any other kind of assistance. The letter M of our building was on no sign and we had to return to the main building and ask for someone to show us where it is. Again, no help was offered with the luggage and we had to haul it up the wet tile stairs ourselves. So not the best start. The next days did not get much better, when I wanted to talk to the concierge, he was nowhere to be found for twenty minutes, I left my room number, but nobody called. At the pool, we were told, we could only sit on one side, since the other side was reserved for cabanas, that could be rented for a hefty fine. That concept caused a lot of confusion and frustration among the guest. There were numerous problems in the room, which we asked to take care of, but nothing happened. I had to fix the sink and other things myself. Not really what I was looking for in a supposedly upper-class place. The staff was gener
reviews.author: HW

reviews.text: the property is beautiful and unique. the pools are amazing. the negative is that the property is like a huge maze and its hard to find your way around.

reviews.text: Went for the pools but will go back for the food. The Tavern, Mowry & Cotton and poolside food all were very good. Great place to stay if you don’t want to leave the resort.

reviews.text: Exhausted from traveling with a late check in. Excited to check into room to find multiple large bugs on the furniture and drapes. Called front desk for help and all they said is “we can send someone to smash them.” Then we go to the bathroom and find trash in a sink. Pull a tissue to blow our nose and a spider comes out. This is supposedly a 5 star resort, definitely not. I was never asked how our stay was, they did not apologize for the bugs in our room. The lady on the phone didn’t even seem to care we had huge insects. Worst customer service we have had at a nice resort. Should have saved our money and stayed at a Motel 6. We have stayed at multiple 5 star resorts and this is not even close. Very disappointing and will never go back.
reviews.author: Verified traveler

reviews.text: This place is a money pit, starting with $35 valet parking when you pull onto the entrance. We had booked a $350-SPA treatment and got a “slot” at 2pm, so we asked for a late check-out which the reception guy charged $150 for. We have had a breakfast credit for $65 included but breakfast was $108 (for two, NO champagne or other gimmicks!!) Deluxe room was adequate but nothing really special. Pool area was nice, but hours were only 10:30a til 5:30p. If you want to celebrate a special occasion like we wanted to do, go to Las Vegas where You get far more bang for your buck. This place is nice but way overpriced, even in Summer when rooms are going for a “cheap” $300 (plus resort fee $35). In Winter, regular rooms are priced up to $800. So if your boss picks up the tab, enjoy it. If not, avoid it.
reviews.author: Verified traveler

reviews.text: Cleanness, hosts.  Resort is very beautiful and hosts are friendly and very helpful.  The only thing we were hoping to have more places to eat.  More casual restaurants and eating places with more reasonable prices would help, since hotel is far from all the city shops and not easy to have access to them.

Bed linens and bathrobes were Frette, which is a nice touch. We were upgraded to a casita with a wonderful view of camelback mountain and the pools. The pools, all 5 or 6 of them, were clean and at the perfect temperature. The restaurants were wonderful and the lobby bar was a great place to relax in. Will definitely stay here again on my next trip to Phoenix/Scottsdale. In addition, they had some nice perks like the pool DJ and the falconer. Wonderful athletic center and spa, if you’re so inclined.

reviews.title: Let down
reviews.text:
It was very apparent that they were understaffed for the Spring break weekend.  The first 24 hours were quite a debacle.  The first night we had dinner at their steak house.  The food was incredible however we were ignored most of the night.  This was not intentional by the server, he was just overwhelmed.  

The following morning we went to breakfast, we were told the wait would be 20 minutes, however we waited closer to an hour before being seated.  We then found our way to the pool to relax on the pool loungers.  30 minutes later a staff member said that the loungers require a $50 fee.  I’m boiling at this point as there were literally 10 loungers to the left and to the right of us!  

Regarding the room.  Be careful of the “pool view” description.  We stayed on the east side and our room faced a concrete slab with a slight view of the pool 200 yards away.   I also found half consumed soda’s in the mini bar.  

I spoke with management and let them know I was displeased.   The lady I spoke with was incredibly kind and helped with booking an offsite dinner reservation and also comped my lunch bill at the pool.   

Beautiful resort however but not worth the $$
reviews.author: Marc

reviews.title: Love
reviews.text: We come here every year.  Love the renovations.  The spa is beautiful!  Amazing tennis courts!  Although the golf course was refreshed, it is the same course.  Service slow in the restaurants.  Although the new Tavern (burger bistro) has yet to reopen.  But overall we love the Phoenician and look forward to coming back next year!
reviews.author: Julie

reviews.text: Property is beautiful and very centrally located in Scottsdale. Although Scottsdale is so big it can still take a long time to get places. I only have two complaints about the property. One, there are no ice machines so you have to call every time you want ice. This took up to 20 minutes at times and it's annoying to feel obligated to tip someone for ice when you are already paying so much. Also, when I called for ice or other questions about half the time I got a recording and several times never got connected to guest services and had to call again. Other than that the rooms are very large and nice with a spacious deck to enjoy the outdoors. The pool area is huge with lots of seating and beautiful views of Camelback Mountain.
reviews.author: Jason

reviews.text: Good trip.  relaxing even with cool weather.  food was great.  service good.  I would avoid  Casitas D, E and F as you back up to the employee parking.  Loud black Charger or Mustang left every morning at 5:30ish very loud (revving engine).  Heat in room was either hot or cold and shower water pressure was very low.  Weekend music was a problem as there was a wedding with live music, a DJ by the pool and the pool surround music on, so it turned into noise and uncomfortable.  Raised the concern to an employee who said it was irritating but could not do anything about it.  Also heard another couple complain too.

reviews.text:
Very large , beautiful resort. Must ask about room views ( mountain, pool,
Parking lot! ) Asked to be close to pool , very helpful. Also must ask for a refrigerator , they do not mention it. If you are not on a budget fine , but food is expensive . We just bought breakfast essentials , yogurt, fruit & bread & they have coffee & tea Kerig in the room. Food by pool is very good. Did not try the only restaurant that was open . We had rented car and explored the area restaurants. The hotel has 3 huge pools ( plus a great children’s area with a Slide!) But they have a lot of “rules” Half the area by the pools are reserved , meaning extra $$ . But there is so much room it won’t effect you. The pools are amazing ! Staff is very helpful too.
Also sign says pool closes at 5:30 , but staff says it open all night . The staff just has to leave , but again they don’ make that clear. It’s so hot , you might not want to leave at 5:30. One thing they can correct , they play loud “ Muzak” through out the pool areas , speakers everywhere. If they would just lower it , trying to rest or listen to your own music is hard.
We asked a pool staff to lower it , he was so helpful & went above & beyond... long story but he lowered the 1 speaker near us . The rest of the days we threw a towel over it .. lol. Oh I forgot the huge Athletic Club it was great !! The rooms are big & comfortable. Get out & walk around resort , lots of nice paths to follow. Remember extra fee for resort & self parking.
reviews.author: Diane

reviews.text: Preferred the decor prior to remodel. It was classic, traditional and opulent. The contemporary look is similar to many other hotels. Nothing to distinguish it from the pack.  The food choices in Mowrey and Cotten were also not what I expected based on prior visits. Choice is limited and too “Southern California “ for me.  We ended up eating off the resort most of our stay.  Obviously the changes are directed to a different crowd than it was previously.  Was disappointed with this visit for those two reasons.

reviews.text: The Phoenician has always been a great place to stay.  However, now with all the improvements they have made it is WONDERFUL!  You cannot go wrong with this property.  Everything is top notch.  Service, room, food, pools, facilities, etc.  Can't wait to go back.
reviews.author: MattTX

reviews.title: Amazing hotel!
reviews.text: Our stay was so wonderful! A beautiful property. The room was quiet and very comfortable. We had the deluxe room with a lovely patio and view of the pool and valley of the sun beyond. Loved everything and cant wait to come back!
reviews.author: sb

reviews.title: A lot to do in the area
reviews.text: Hotel, rooms , pools , spa, workout room all beautiful. Plenty of things to do.
reviews.author: Brian

reviews.title: Problem with refund on SPA treatments advertised
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed at the Pheonician recently. In the room,  the hotel offered one free SPA treatment if you purchased one. When I arrived home I called the hotel to inquire as to why we were not offered the discount as we did book 3 treatments. The SPA representative advised that after she spoke with her manager, they decided that they would not honor their offer as I requested it the day that we returned home from our trip. I was very disappointed.
reviews.author: Verified traveler

reviews.title: Not Enough Value
reviews.text: Amenities are CLOSED for renovations. Want to play golf or take your kid in the kiddie pool? Think again, half of the things at this resort are under construction... including some restaurants, tennis courts golf areas etc... Spend your money elsewhere.
reviews.author: Mascielo

reviews.title: Perfect spot for getaway!!!!
reviews.text: Weekend for Father’s Day, wish we could’ve stay longer, the word perfect definitely describe our vocation. Services was great, beautiful view. Definitely will go back soon!!!
reviews.author: Intong

reviews.text: Great stay from start to finish. Will be back soon.
reviews.author: Verified traveler

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: We visit Scottsdale every year. This was our first time at The Phoenician. The service , cleanliness, and atmosphere was stellar!  We will definitely return.
reviews.author: Verified traveler

reviews.text: Awesome stay!  Definitely worth it if you plan on staying in Scottsdale!
reviews.author: Wayne

reviews.text:
Great central location, pool remodel nice. 
Golf not done yet  but plenty else to do. Staff wonderful and happy to serve you
reviews.author: Verified traveler

reviews.title: Girlfriends weekend
reviews.text: Girlfriends getaway weekend. We had an amazing time. Ate dinner and brunch at Mowry and Cotton...great food, great wine. Service was outstanding. Free room upgrade  (without asking). Everyone at the resort was super friendly and accommodating. Will definitely come back again!!

reviews.title: High class
reviews.text: We stayed in fire casita this past week. Place just about finish with master Reno—golf course still closed—which we knew. Rooms all new and modern. Bed comfy and views to die for all around. We were looking at Camelback and it was majestic each morning to sit a drink coffee and relax.
reviews.author: KATE

reviews.text: Fabuloso
reviews.author: Patricia

reviews.title: A beautiful and peaceful hotel.
reviews.text: This is one of my favorite hotels. The entire property has a tranquil vibe.
reviews.author: Brent

reviews.text: Our room overlooked the parking circle of the resort. There was no overnight hotel staff to monitor the noise.  We were awakened in the middle of the night on two of our seven nights by drunken revelers and a by a motorcyclist revving his engine.  Every evening we were treated to the sound of carts passing our room on the way to and from the service station that was also right by our room.  This major inconvenience prevented us from fully relaxing, which was one of the most important reasons for choosing this resort.
reviews.author: Verified traveler

reviews.text: We were disappointed the golf course was under construction and the spa was being completed so services didn't start until 12:30 each day so they upgraded us to a casita. We were able to check in 2 hours early and check out an hour late which helped accommodate our schedule.
reviews.author: Verified traveler

reviews.title: Not enough staff
reviews.text: We stayed ina$800+/night suite for 3 days and waited over 2 hours for our kids to get sheets and blankets for the pull out sofas.(which were Very cheap and uncomfortable)). No one offered to make the beds. We were promised early check in and told the guests prior had left at noon. At 2:00 when I went to check in the guests were still in the room? Yet we have to check out at 1:00 no matter what... really! The grounds are very nice. Relish is the only normal place to eat, but a burger is $25. Plan on going off property for every meal. EVERYTHING is at least double what it should be, which I somewhat expected. You have to pay extra to use the safe in your room! We tried to get lunch poolside and couldn’t find anyone and gave up again and went off property. They are catering to the big banker convention going on now and I guess forgot about their other guests. My kids are older,  but was told by several guests if you wanted to put your kids in their day camp that it books up months in advance. Again under staffed!
reviews.author: Verified traveler

reviews.title: Fantastic Service at a Fantastic Property
reviews.text: This hotel was top notch from the check in service to the daily interactions we had with the staff at the pools and restaurants.  The new spa is now open and the only construction going on can be seen only when driving in and out of the resort (and the noise was thus non existent).  We also had a room that overlooked the golf course construction but were never bothered by any noise at any time of the time.
reviews.author: Jess

reviews.text: We had a fabulous time at the pool and the staff was fantastic. We never had our rooms cleaned and I reported our phones were not working in the room with no response.
reviews.author: Virginia

reviews.text:

Sehr schlechtes Preis Leistungsverhälnis. 
Desolater Zustand

reviews.title: Wonderful rooms and service
reviews.text: It is a wonderful property - this time of year... was not too busy and the service was amazing.
reviews.author: Katherine

reviews.title: Canyon Suites at the Phoenician
reviews.text: We stayed in the Canyon Suites and not the hotel proper. The staff were amazing, especially Kate and Jordan at the concierge desk. Beautiful and spacious room! Breakfast was included with delicious options and gracious service considering it was a buffet. Loved it!
reviews.author: sally

reviews.text: Great hotel, the pool was awesome.  Our room was very nice.  They do have some construction going on but they didn't start working until 8:00am and we never heard it at night.
reviews.author: Verified traveler

reviews.title: Huge hotel in midst of property improvements
reviews.text: Housecleaning staff does not speak English. Impossible to get them to understand to not knock on our door b4 10.   First room front door was adjacent to porta-potties on construction site. Upgraded to a room with firepit but the propane was empty.   Wait till they finish renovations.
reviews.author: Verified traveler

reviews.text: Golf course and spa we’re not available as both were under new construction. Both are key considerations and we were not aware when we booked that this was the case.
reviews.author: Susan

reviews.title: Good life
reviews.text: Love the new lobby and bar that flows to the fabulous patio.   Pricey but not crazy
reviews.author: James

reviews.text: Loved it. We will be back. Can't wait to try the new spa when it's finished. It is currently under construction so we did not get to enjoy.

reviews.title: Fabulous Large Resort
reviews.text: The Phoenician is a fabulous large resort on the edge of Scottsdale. We are a family of 5 and there was plenty of choices for everyone including tennis, bilking, pool, hot tub, kids club and golf.  The service was very good even though the hotel was at capacity.  The dining options were also great from the J & G steak house to the buffet breakfast to the food at the pool.

reviews.title: Quality rating but lots to fix
reviews.text: Housekeeping couldn't keep up with occupancy, missing towels, soaps, one day no housekeeping service provided.  Water pressure and temp consistently horrible.  B'fast buffet missing because "we only have buffet when we're at full capacity"....For quality rating, this hotel has lots of work to do with basic amenities.

reviews.title: Resort exceeded my expectations!

reviews.title: Beautiful views!

reviews.title: AMAZING 3 DAYS IN THIS PLACE !

reviews.author: Yasmin

reviews.title: under renovations was an understatment
reviews.text: The Phoenician is well known for its extravagant pools and hot tubs. I planned this trip as a summer close out for my girlfriends birthday that was on sept. 1st. Once we arrived we were greeted by the staff which was fine, then they told me their main pool area is completely closed. Oh but they do have a tennis court size pool on the other end of the resort that we could drive to... that also doesn't even have a Jacuzzi.  I asked if there was any chance we could use the spas Jacuzzi? ... Also closed for renovations. This was suppose to be a nice get away and all the amenities they could offer was a bar. Seeing how neither of us drink, we almost canceled the reservation right there. We reluctantly decided to go ahead because we were sure the room was going to be really nice. I had paid for an upgraded casita which I was excited to see. Once we got into the room it did not take long to see that the renovations had also made it into the room as well. It looked as if all the countertops, top of the toilet and tub had all been sprinkled with drywall and other construction dust. needless to say we did not use the bathtub I paid for and had upgraded for the stay. We spent the majority of the time away from the room, just to finally go back and have a nice nights sleep that ended at 630 to the sound of construction outside our window. I've stayed at this resort before but was very unimpressed this time around. By far the worst resort experience I've ever had.
reviews.author: Brodie

reviews.title: The best location in Scottsdale right on Camelback
reviews.text: Incredible service , beautiful room, fabulous food. We did not have time to golf but would love to come back. The only exception was the remodel that is currently happening the  garden pool is lovely put a bit far from your room.

reviews.author: Verified traveler

reviews.title: Construction disruption
reviews.text: Construction when we showed up, so main pool was closed. Disappointing with no announcement during booking process, and having to shuttle to the pool with kids. Also a very big property.  Otherwuse, a great location, excellent staff and beautiful grounds.
reviews.author: Verified traveler

reviews.title: Under Renovation
reviews.text: We were surprised to arrive and find the hotel under total renovation.   This information was not provided when we made our reservation, had we known we would have booked somewhere else.   Even though our room was clean and comfortable, it was located absolutely the furthest from the lobby.   All the pools were closed and the only pool available was located at the exact opposite of where our room was.  This made even wanting to go to the pool unappetizing.  We booked the room so that we could use their famous spa amenities only to be told only limited spa options were available and those we wanted were either unavailable or limited due to staff reductions caused by the renovations underway.  We therefore spent most of our time away from the resort...in other words we went to the "Mall".   Fashion Square mall is conveniently located about 2 miles away.

reviews.title: Remodel
reviews.text: Found bugs in my bed also unaware of the remodeling going on. It was a mess.

reviews.title: Our weekend at The Phoenician
reviews.text: Very expensive. We were under the impression that during the construction/remodel phase that things would be priced competitively. Not the case. $29 daily "resort" fee. Come on. Money is better spent at Monteluccia.

Need to provide better transportation while under construction. Walking around in 105 degree heat........

reviews.title: Three days of Sunshine
reviews.text:
The resort was on the cusp of their remodel start-up. Some areas were obvious to a stagnate point.
No big deal, with the exception we were paying a room rate of a 5 star hotel and it was slightly lacking.
Housekeeping missed cleaning our room on one day. A phone request for K-cups (coffee) took over 45 minutes, I finally left the room before it was delivered. One pool area lounge chairs were so close it was uncomfortable. The buffet breakfast was amazing. I did not understand the delay for breakfast patio seating every morning. Maybe the idea of waiting was to soothe the $$$charge.? Tennis facility was perfect. The greeting staff outside and the golf cart drivers were spot on and friendly!!
reviews.author: Verified traveler

reviews.title: True Luxury
reviews.text: Want to feel totally pampered?  Go to the Phoenician.  From the friendly staff to the gorgeous, newly renovated rooms, it's truly a luxury hotel.  Cannot wait for the renovations to be completed!
reviews.author: Laura

reviews.title: Anthony: A Great First Impression
reviews.text: We pulled up in our rental car and met the most amazing person named Anthony at the valet!! Anthony could not have made us feel more welcome and more comfortable!! For the next 4 days Anthony called us by name. Always asking what he could do for us!! After that, customer service was minimal. Dined at JG Steakhouse twice during our visit. 2nd visit called and spoke to the RUDEST person ever, named Bree. Bree was very condescending and abrupt!! Spoke with Patrick, Bree's manager, who blew me off!! Moral of story - you can have the nicest of resorts but, if you don't treat your customers nicely then your beautiful resort turns UGLY!!
reviews.author: Tarie

reviews.title: Incredible Service - Beautiful Property
reviews.text: From the moment you enter the property, you are greeted by staff that is warm, genuine and dedicated to ensuring your experience is fantastic! Everyone from Brent at the Valet, to Michelle in Concierge, to Salvador at the Oasis Poolside Café went that extra mile to make you feel like a VIP! The hotel was immaculate, the grounds were beautifully manicured -- and against the backdrop of Camelback Mountain -- it was a visual treat simply walking around the property! We ate a several restaurants on property and indulged in room service -- and the food and service were both fantastic!!!
reviews.author: Sean

reviews.title: Beautiful property, but room amenities not so good
reviews.text:
I stayed at the Phoenician 10 years ago, before all of the renovations were made to the property and had an amazing experience. Not so much this time. We paid more for a casita with a view on the golf course, but they put us right on the main driveway overlooking the restaurant, where several corporate parties were going on over the 6 nights we were there. Very disappointing, especially because other casitas with views close by us were unoccupied the entire time (wonder if they put us on the main road because we got a deal on the room through Expedia?). 

Although the rooms were beautifully decorated/renovated, the bed was hard as a rock; the towels were old, rough, and had holes in them; the plush bathrobes from my past stay were replaced with thin, cheaper ones (and the desk clerk even warned me to "hold on to the old one" because they're not as nice as the ones they have now). 

The spa did not meet my expectations. I called in advance to make my appointments and talked at length with "Emily" to book the perfect massage - which was NOT booked when I got there. So they scrambled to try to fit me in - it was very rushed and not relaxing. 

Food and Beverage was just average, we ate off property after the first night.
reviews.author: Renee

reviews.text: Great location for resort.   Casita location was poor, located next to the incoming street, parking deck and noisy.

reviews.title: Great hotel in Scottsdale
reviews.text: Very solid hotel, nice rooms, lobby and pool areas. We came here for Xmas break with the family and spent a nice week at the hotel. The hotel was a bit overcrowded, both at the pool areas and in the lobby, but overall we definitely enjoyed our stay. The hotel stuff was always helpful. The breakfast at JG is awesome.
reviews.author: Andrey

reviews.title: Beautiful resort, lots of activities
reviews.text: Our Christmas experience at The Phoenician was incredible.  We dined at a different restaurant every day, enjoyed a couples massage in the spa, hung by the pool, climbed Camelback Mountain and explored downtown Scottsdale.  Our 5 day trip was certainly fun and memorable.

reviews.title: Superior staff!

reviews.author: Verified traveler

reviews.title: Great pools

reviews.text: Considering we have stayed many many times there  the walk to our room was horrible it was freezing in the hallway it affected my back  my phone w was not working for a day you now charge for parking, , very dussapointed          regards joanne appugliesi
reviews.author: joanneappuglies

reviews.title: Really a terrific holiday treat
reviews.text: I stayed on December 2nd for one day, it is a wonderful resort.  I usually stay at the Wigwam in Litchfield Park, but this year I needed to be closer to Scottsdale.  The Phoenician at this time of year is beautiful.  There are lights wrapped around the cactus, something from my childhood that I love, the walkway next to Camelback Mountain should not be missed and the lobby just is so warm and beautiful.  If you need to get around the resort without walking, there is always someone at the ready with a golf cart.  The pools were not crowded at all.  I was particularly attracted to the mother of pearl, adult pool....quiet and perfect.  The staff was attentive, I cannot say enough about the women at the concierge desks.  They were very knowledgeable, warm and funny.  My room had a nice balcony and a great view of the sun coming up over the palm trees.  I will review the restaurants separately, but they were wonderful.  Service was hit and miss at Burger Relish, and the sliders were a bit overdone. Would return in a heartbeat.

reviews.title: Excellent long weekend
reviews.text: Enjoy the long weekend. Did not get to enjoy the pool as much as we'd like to put the hotel was wonderful.

reviews.title: Good hotel, great location
reviews.text: Based on the glowing reviews of this hotel we had very high expectations for The Phoenician.  We were somewhat disappointed but this may have been primarily due to the week that we chose to visit.  We were there mid-March and the place was overflowing with guests.  There was always a haphazard, lengthy queue waiting to speak to anyone at the front desk or concierge.  There was scarcely a place by the pool to sit during the day and we actually witnessed guests fighting over pool chairs, disrupting others around them, due to the limited space.  The pool area is really not laid out to accommodate the large numbers of guests so if you are going with family or friends, arrive by 9am at the pool to ensure you find a few chairs together in your preferred spot.  The restaurant was good but they were not very knowledgeable about serving children - my 4 year old repeatedly received his chocolate milk in a tall stemmed water glass (accident waiting to happen) and though we ordered for them off the kids menu we were charged full price on several items repeatedly. The lobby is beautiful, the valet was well staffed and quick, the airport and highway are easily accessible and Old Town Scottsdale is just minutes away.  Bottom line, though it is a nice hotel, I think it was rather overpriced and overrated for the quality and service that we received during our visit.
